title: An Act to Protect Consumers by Increasing Transparency and Accountability in the Pharmaceutical Industry
committee_name: Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services

summary.text:
This bill is a concept draft pursuant to Joint Rule 208.

This bill proposes to increase transparency and accountability in the pharmaceutical industry to protect consumers of this State.

status_label: Ought Not to Pass Pursuant To Joint Rule 310
